resources.string: Open HourByHour and allow calendar access
HourByHour reads the events in your phone\'s calendar, which Google Calendar keeps in sync. No sign-in: your data never leaves your phone.
Calendar access allowed. Add the widget to your home screen and resize it as you like.
Add the widget to the home screen
With 5 days or more: shows the week from Monday. Once the chosen days are over, shows the next week.
If you just created a calendar and it is not here, open Google Calendar and tap Refresh in its menu: the phone downloads new calendars only now and then.
No calendars synced to the phone.
